settings.text: Wrap a thin strip of paper snugly around the base of your finger and mark where it overlaps. Measure the length in millimeters — that's your circumference.
Measure at the end of the day, when your fingers are at their largest. Avoid measuring when your hands are cold.
If a ring that fits is already in hand, measure its inside diameter and match it to the table above.
Wider bands wear more snugly — for bands over 6mm, consider going up half a size.
